1. SCOPE
1.1 This standard specifies the constructional and performance requirements of wet heat and dry heat bains marie for use with liquefied petroleum gases at a working pressure of 30 gficms. --*General requirementsfor do!nesticand commercial equipment for use with LPG.

2. TERMINOLOGY 2;O For the'purpose of this standard, the following definitions, to those given in 2 of IS : 5116-1969*, shall apply.

in addition

2.1 Bains Marie-An

appliance for keeping cooked food hot in bulk

2.2 Open Bains Marie-A shallow receptacle containing water and i heated from below. Pots and pans containing cooked food are stored in it to be kept hot. 2.3 Fitted Bains Marie ( Wet ) - Same as open bains marie except that the top is covered with containers fitted into it. Cooked food is transfered to these containers to be kept hot. 2.4 Fitted Bains Marie (Dry) -Same as wet .heat bains marie without a water well in which the containers are kept hot by the circulation of thermostat controlled hot air. 3. MATERIAL 3.1 The reievant material requirements shall apply. 4. CONSTRUCTION 4.0 In addition to the relevant c&structional requirements given in Section 1 of IS : 5 116-1969*, the requirements given in 4.1 and 4.2 shall apply. 4.1 A \vet bains marie filled to the level recommended by the manufacturer shall not have boiled dry two hours after lighting with the gas tap full on The test and the thermostat, if variable, turned to its maximum setting. shall be conducted at an inlet pressure to give 120 percent of normal rating. 4.2 A fixed setting thermostat shall be set to within f 5 deg of the nominal working temperature. 5. PERFORMANCE 5.0 In addition to the relevant performance requirements in Section 2 of IS : 5116-1969*, requirements given in 5.1 to 5.3 shall apply. 5.1 Combustion - When sampled as detailed in 5.1.1 the CO/CO2 ratio shall not exceed 0.02 percent with individually heated sections operatin: alone and also in conjunction with associated units. ___._____. __~____ *General requirementsfor domes:ic and commercial equipment for use with LPG. 3 , given in Section 1 of IS : 5116-1969*

5.2 Re@rements

for Wet Heat Bains Marie

5.2.1 Heating Test-When tested as given in Appendix A, the time required to heat the water in the bains marie well from 15" to 80DC shall not be more than 60 minutes using Test Gas A. 5.2.2 Tcmpraturt Maiyz-tenance Test - When tested in accordance with Appendix B, the heat input required to maintain water in the bains marie well at average of 65 deg above room temperature using Test Gas A shall not exceed 4000 kcal/h for a bains marie of less than 0.4 m* in area or 2 700 kcai/h for a bains marie of area of 0.4 ms or over.
5.3

Requirement

for Dry Heat or Steam Heat Bains Marie

5.3.1 Heating Test-When tested in -accordance with Appendix C, the heating time required before water in the container be maintained at a temperature rise of 65 deg above room temperature using Test Gas A shall not exceed 45 minutes.
5.33 Temperature Maintenance Test - When tested as given in Appendix D, the heat input required to maintain the temperature of water in the fitted containers at an average of 65 deg above room temperature using Test Gas A shall not exceed 4000 kcal/h for bains marie with O-4 ms in area and 2 700 kcal,`h for a bains marie in area of 0.4 ms or above.

5.3.3 Food Warming Test-When tested in accordance with .4ppendix E, it shall be possible to maintain the food at a temperature not lower than 70�C in the containers without overheating using Test Gas A. 6. APPENDIX ( Clause 5.3.3 )
FOOD El. WARMING TEST FOR DRY

E
HEAT BAINS MARIE

OBJECT

E-l.1 To determine whether food can be maintained at a temperature not lower than 70�C in the containers without overheating or scorching, using Test Gas A. E2. PROCEDURE '

E-2.1 Place the food cantainers in the appliance and cover with the lids. Set the thermostats ( if any) as recommended by the manufacturer and turn the gas tap full on. Light the burner and allow the appliance to heat up - for 45 minutes. The quantity of food (porridge) required for the test is previously ascertained by filling the containers with water to the level of the surrounding bains marie. This water is transferred to a pan. Adding 50 g of rolled oats to each half litre of water in the pan, cook. thoroughly by bringing to a_ quick boil and then sim,mering for' 10 minutes. Stir contrnuously at first and occasionally while simmering. Cool to 85" to 88�C Replace the lids. and pour the required amount into each container. E-3. OBSERVATIONS E-3.1 The following tests are run consecutively using Test Gas A: *:

a) Stir the mixture well every 10 minutes and note the temperature After 50 minutes examine for thickness of deposit on sides reading. an?l base, sticking or burning. 7

lS:5543-1970 b) if the above requirements are met, return the mixture to the cuntainers, reheating to 85" to 88% if necessary. Remet thelidsand repeat the test for tirther 60 minutes. In this time, the temperature shall not have dropped more than 5 deg of its starting point and the deposits shall comply with the requirements in (a) above.
C)

If the above .requirements are met, do not. r&e& but leave tlk yorridge undisturbed for a further 30 minutes.and again measure the temperature in each container. Empty. the -contains and examine for sticking atid scorching. In thii time, tbe temperature `I shall not fall during the last 30 minutes more than 5 deg below the temperature at the start of this part of the test. The deposit shalI not stick to such an extent that it cannot be removed by rubbing with a cloth.
